name: Genimous Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Genimous Technology Co., Ltd. engages in Internet media, digital marketing, and Internet finance businesses in China and internationally. The company operates through Internet Media Business, The Digital Marketing Business, and Other business segments. It provides self-developed browsers, content websites, mobile applications, desktop plugins, and value-added services; chain marketing service, including brand promotion, performance conversion, and sales conversion; and home theater products, portable outdoor speakers, and Bluetooth headphones under the Vifa, Ailang, Zhujiang, and Aiwei brand names.
